newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Mexico's Zedillo to boost oil industry safety.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Zedillo to boost oil industry safety.

text.p: President Ernesto Zedillo said Wednesday he was calling for increased safety measures at oil installations in the wake of an explosion at a Mexico City fuel storage which killed three.
"We are calling on specialists to give recommendations to boost safety measures and reduce (the possibility of accidents) to practically zero," he told a news conference in Argentina.
But he added: "First of all before anything else I would like to see the technical verdict telling us the causes of this disaster.
The disaster struck when workers for state-owned oil firm Pemex were repairing a valve in a tank containing 80,000 barrels of fuel at a storage facility.
More than 5,000 people were evacuated from their homes in the northern suburb of San Juan Ixhuatepec while emergency workers struggled to control the blaze.
Zedillo, who is on a three-day visit to Argentina, said he had closely followed reports of Tuesday's accident.
